bootstrap.scheme: Sample represented calendar years with replacement, n_draws=n_represented_years. Every year occurrence retains its distinct represented months. Common draws for all methods within each stratum; RNG restarts at the configured seed for each stratum.
bootstrap.scope: Marginal paired test-year percentile 95% intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted, training-seed, refitting or selection uncertainty. Fixed models and one shared realization per control. One-year intervals unavailable. No two-year stratum intervals or p-values. Historically exposed test, not blind confirmation.

diagnostic_scope: Each diffusion diagnostic uses its own 39-draw ensemble, then equal means over three fixed seeds. Never pool 117 draws. Each control is one realization, broadcast only for paired contrasts.

input_manifest.raw_hash_scope: Copied from artifacts/inventory/summary.json; raw OMNI files are not reread or independently reverified here.

strata_scope: Descriptive, target-defined exploratory diagnostics on frozen primary energy scores. No redraw, refit, changed target, selection or forecast. Calendar groups are numeric, not pure solar maximum/minimum regimes; source and year mixes are descriptive, not causal.
support_scope: Support violation fractions check inequalities only, not full realizability: they do not test R=0. r_obs_mean separately reports mean absolute R.

hidden_mean_m.population: full frozen test targets; counts are not forced equal

hidden_mean_vector_step.population: full frozen test targets; counts are not forced equal

weighting.mean: Equal window means per fixed seed, then equal seed mean; not month balanced.
weighting.month_balanced: Equal represented-month means per fixed seed, then equal seed mean.
